description: record_version values a verifier accepts or rejects, for the TransactionRecord (Section 9.5, steps 1 and 7) and the SessionEvidenceRecord (Sections 9A.2 and 9A.6). Producers emit producers_emit. Each artifact's version follows its record's shape. A TransactionRecord producer emits "0.1" for a session that fixed no basis and "0.2" for a session that fixed one, so a "0.2" record carries a top-level basis and a "0.1" record carries none. A SessionEvidenceRecord producer emits "0.3" for a record that carries external_commitment_reference and "0.2" for one that does not. The AuditLog carries its version in log_version. Both suites take a valid record, set record_version to a value (a rejected case with no record_version key removes the key), recompute record_hash and, for the SessionEvidenceRecord, the producer seal, and assert the verdict. The TransactionRecord of each shape is the record transaction-record-basis.json replays to: session_with_basis is its basis session and session_without_basis its without_basis session. The SessionEvidenceRecord without_external_commitment is the record session-evidence-record-parity.json produces, resealed with that file's producer_private_jwk, and with_external_commitment is the record session-evidence-record-external-channel.json produces, resealed with its own. Each accepted TransactionRecord version verifies on the shape that emits it, and each accepted SessionEvidenceRecord version on the shape it names; "0.1", which no current producer emits, verifies on the shape without external_commitment_reference, whose rules do not depend on the version. Each cross_shape case puts a recognized version on the other shape of its artifact and fails verification. Every rejected value fails verification on both shapes of its artifact, instead of being parsed best-effort. "0.3" is a recognized SessionEvidenceRecord version, and the TransactionRecord still rejects it.
